name: Escape Through Force
summary: Escape Through Force is an Alliance quest in Darkshore where the adventurer helps Volcor break through surrounding threats by direct combat. After fighting past the perils of the wild to reach the road and reunite with his faithful companion Grimclaw, the player reports Volcor's safe escape back to Terenthis in Auberdine.

sections.title: A Direct Way Out
sections.body: When stranded in the perilous wilderness of Darkshore, subtle movement is not always the chosen path. Faced with danger, the night elf Volcor accepts a blunt strategy: cutting directly through the surrounding hostile creatures to reach safety. Rather than attempting to slip away unseen, Volcor relies on martial prowess to carve a corridor straight down to the main road.

sections.title: Reunion on the Road
sections.body: Reaching the thoroughfare safely allows Volcor to reunite with Grimclaw, his stalwart bear companion who has been waiting by the path. With their escape secured, Volcor prepares for his next journey while urging the adventurer to report directly to Terenthis in Auberdine. Delivering news of Volcor's safety reassures the night elf leadership and immediately draws the attention of Sentinel Selarin, pointing toward deeper troubles brewing southward in Ashenvale.

faq.answer: Volcor is a night elf scout or woodsman in Darkshore who went missing along with his companion Grimclaw. After being located by adventurers searching on behalf of Terenthis, he requires assistance escaping hostile wildlife and dangerous terrain.
Grimclaw is Volcor's loyal companion bear. During Volcor's entrapment, Grimclaw remained separated near the road, serving as the landmark rendezvous point for Volcor's escape.

faq.q: Why does Terenthis care about Volcor's return?
faq.answer: Terenthis coordinates scout movements and local defense efforts out of Auberdine. Tracking down lost allies and assessing threats along the coastline is critical to maintaining night elf control across a rapidly destabilizing Darkshore.

faq.q: What happens after completing this quest?
faq.answer: Report Volcor's safe passage to Terenthis in Auberdine. The chain then leads to Trek to Ashenvale.

faq.q: Is there an alternate way to finish Volcor's escort?
faq.answer: Yes. When rescuing Volcor, adventurers are offered a choice in approach: fighting their way out head-on via Escape Through Force, or guiding him quietly past danger using stealth.

faq.q: Where does this quest lead in the broader storyline?
faq.answer: Securing Volcor's survival serves as a bridge between the local conflicts of Darkshore and the larger regional defense of the night elf lands, directly opening up assignments in Ashenvale.

angles.text: Rescuing scouts like Volcor is vital to the Kaldorei's tenuous grip on Darkshore, where wild beasts, corruption, and outside invaders threaten their ancestral woodlands.
Assisting local scouts deepens the bond between the young Alliance and the Night Elves, proving the faction's value in securing Kalimdor's northern frontier.
